headline: Approved minutes of nine earlier meetings and accepted 2026 General Election results, closing the polls.
summary: Election results from the 2026 General Election were read out and accepted, and the polls were closed. Minutes from nine earlier meetings were also approved.
decisions: Approved minutes of nine earlier meetings, 3-0.
Accepted 2026 General Election results and closed the polls, 3-0.

decision_titles: Minutes of nine meetings, March 26 to September 22, 2026
transcript:
# City of Central Falls

## Board of Canvassers Meeting

Central Falls City Hall
580 Broad St. Central Falls, RI 02863

Tuesday, November 3, 2026

6 am

Minutes (posted 11/16/2026)

1. Roll Call

The meeting was called to order at 6:00 am by Chair Ryan Oldmixon. Roll call was conducted, and the following members were present: Belmiro Bala, Board Member; John Marenzana, Board Member; and Ryan Oldmixon, Chair. A quorum was established

2. Pledge of Allegiance

Chair Oldmixon led the board in the pledge of allegiance

3. Approval of records

a. March 26, 2026 Minutes

b. June 11, 2026 Minutes

c. July 9, 2026 Minutes

d. July 15, 2026 Minutes

e. July 20, 2026 Minutes

f. August 4, 2026 Minutes

g. September 9, 2026 Minutes

h. September 16, 2026 Minutes

i. September 22, 2026 Minutes

Chair, Ryan Oldmixon asked whether the Board Members had an opportunity to review the minutes and whether anyone had any questions or concerns. Seeing none and hearing none, he requested a motion to approve the minutes. Board Member, Belmiro Bala made the motion to approve, seconded by Board Member John Marrenzana. The motion passed unanimously, 3-0, with the Chair voting in favor.

4. Board members will tabulate election procedures and inspections of polling locations for the 2026 General Election.

Without objection Board Chair, Ryan Oldmixon opened the November 3, 2026 Election at 6am.

5. Board members will tabulate election results after the closing of the polls.

Board Chair, Ryan read out the 2026 General Election results. Board Member, John Marenzana made a motion to accept results and close the polls. Board Member Belmiro Bala seconded and the motion passed 3-0, with the Chair voting in favor.

6. Adjournment

Meeting was called to adjournment at 10:04 pm. The motion was made by Belmiro Bala, Board Member, and seconded by John Marenzana, Board Member. Motion passed 3-0, with the Chair voting in favor.
